data.title: The hillfort volume is selling fast
data.excerpt: The long-awaited second volume of Hradiská – Svedkovia dávnych čias came out in November in a print run of 700 copies. Fewer than 200 of them are still left, so anyone interested should order a copy as soon as possible.
data.metaTitle: The hillfort volume is selling fast
data.metaDescription: Fewer than 200 of the 700 printed copies of Hradiská – Svedkovia dávnych čias 2 remain; anyone interested should order a copy as soon as possible.

children.text: In November we published our long-awaited volume Hradiská – Svedkovia dávnych čias 2. We had 700 copies printed, and as of today fewer than 200 of them are left. I therefore recommend that anyone interested in the volume order it as soon as possible.
So if you are interested, do not hesitate and
. I would remind you that the first volume sold out within a month in 2016 and that no reprint is planned.
